functions.cv_pd_ds_ten:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cv_pd_ds_ten(p_ten text)
 RETURNS uuid[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(array_agg(distinct u.user_id), '{}')
  from user_roles u
  where nullif(trim(coalesce(p_ten, '')), '') is not null
    and (coalesce(nullif(trim(u.full_name), ''), nullif(trim(u.username), ''), u.email, '') = trim(p_ten)
         or nullif(trim(u.username), '') = trim(p_ten)
         or lower(u.email) = lower(trim(p_ten))
         or (nullif(trim(u.username), '') is not null and nullif(trim(u.full_name), '') is not null
             and trim(u.username) || '_' || trim(u.full_name) = trim(p_ten)));
$function$
functions.cv_pd_gui:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cv_pd_gui(p_nguoi uuid[], p_nguon text, p_loai text, p_khoa text, p_lien_ket text, p_noi_dung text, p_can_xu_ly boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_n int;
begin
  insert into cv_thong_bao (nguoi_nhan, loai, cong_viec_id, du_an_id, noi_dung, can_xu_ly, nguon, lien_ket, khoa)
  select distinct u, p_loai, null::bigint, null::bigint, p_noi_dung, coalesce(p_can_xu_ly, false), p_nguon, p_lien_ket, p_khoa
  from unnest(coalesce(p_nguoi, '{}')) u
  where u is not null and u is distinct from auth.uid()
    and exists (select 1 from user_roles r where r.user_id = u)
    and not (coalesce(p_can_xu_ly, false) and exists (
      select 1 from cv_thong_bao t
      where t.khoa = p_khoa and t.nguoi_nhan = u and t.can_xu_ly and not t.da_xu_ly));
  get diagnostics v_n = row_count;
  return v_n;
end;
$function$
functions.cv_pd_xong:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cv_pd_xong(p_khoa text, p_tien_to boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  update cv_thong_bao set da_xu_ly = true
  where can_xu_ly and not da_xu_ly and khoa is not null and p_khoa is not null
    and (khoa = p_khoa or (p_tien_to and left(khoa, length(p_khoa)) = p_khoa));
$function$
functions.ipqc_do_du_lieu:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ipqc_do_du_lieu(p_ma_sp text, p_tu timestamp with time zone, p_den timestamp with time zone, p_so_lan integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with b as (select * from ipqc_btk where ma_sp = p_ma_sp and dang_dung),
  lan as (
    select l.*, c.ket_qua from ipqc_do_lan l join duc_ipqc_checkpoint c on c.id_checkpoint = l.id_checkpoint and c.ket_qua is not null
    where l.ma_sp = p_ma_sp
      and (p_so_lan is not null or ((p_tu is null or l.thoi_diem >= p_tu) and (p_den is null or l.thoi_diem <= p_den)))
    order by l.thoi_diem desc limit coalesce(p_so_lan, 5000)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'btk', (select to_jsonb(b) from b),
    'muc', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) order by m.muc_no), '[]'::jsonb) from ipqc_btk_muc m where m.id_btk = (select id from b)),
    'gioi_han', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(h)), '[]'::jsonb) from ipqc_gioi_han h where h.ma_sp = p_ma_sp and h.dang_dung),
    'lan', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id_checkpoint', l.id_checkpoint, 'thoi_diem', l.thoi_diem, 'ma_may', l.ma_may,
              'so_khuon', l.so_khuon, 'nguoi', l.nguoi, 'dat', l.dat, 'ket_qua', l.ket_qua,
              'kq', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('muc_no', k.muc_no, 'mau', k.mau, 'gia_tri', k.gia_tri, 'dat', k.dat)
                       order by k.muc_no, k.mau), '[]'::jsonb) from ipqc_do_kq k where k.id_checkpoint = l.id_checkpoint))
            order by l.thoi_diem), '[]'::jsonb) from lan l));
$function$
functions.ipqc_gioi_han_tu_khoa:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ipqc_gioi_han_tu_khoa(p_ma_sp text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare m record; g jsonb;
begin
  for m in select mu.muc_no from ipqc_btk b join ipqc_btk_muc mu on mu.id_btk = b.id
           where b.ma_sp = p_ma_sp and b.dang_dung and mu.kieu = 'so'
             and not exists (select 1 from ipqc_gioi_han h where h.ma_sp = p_ma_sp and h.muc_no = mu.muc_no and h.dang_dung)
  loop
    g := ipqc_gioi_han_tinh(p_ma_sp, m.muc_no, null, null, 30);
    if g is not null and (g ->> 'n_lan')::int >= 30 then
      insert into ipqc_gioi_han (ma_sp, muc_no, so_mau, cl, ucl, lcl, cl_r, ucl_r, n_lan, cach, ghi_chu, nguoi)
      values (p_ma_sp, m.muc_no, (g ->> 'so_mau')::int, (g ->> 'cl')::numeric, (g ->> 'ucl')::numeric, (g ->> 'lcl')::numeric,
        (g ->> 'cl_r')::numeric, (g ->> 'ucl_r')::numeric, 30, 'tu_dong', 'Tự khoá sau 30 lần đo đầu', 'Hệ thống');
    end if;
  end loop;
end $function$
